text:
### Right to Object  
**Customer Right:** Object to processing  
**Scope:**
- Direct marketing: Can opt out (mandatory)
- Profiling/automated decisions: Can object
- Legitimate interest processing: Can object if no compelling reason  
**Marketing Opt-Out:**
- Email preference: link in every marketing email
- Phone preference: request to support team
- SMS preference: text "STOP" to number
- Recorded immediately in system

raw_entities.name: Right to Object Policy
raw_entities.description: Policy governing customer rights to object to data processing, including direct marketing, profiling, automated decision-making, and legitimate interest processing. Establishes mandatory opt-out mechanisms across email, phone, and SMS channels with immediate system recording.
context: Legitimate interest processing: Can object if no compelling reason

raw_entities.name: Mandatory Direct Marketing Opt-Out
raw_entities.description: Customers must be provided with the ability to opt out of direct marketing communications. This is a mandatory provision that applies to all direct marketing activities.

raw_entities.name: Profiling and Automated Decision Objection Right
raw_entities.description: Customers have the right to object to profiling and automated decision-making processes conducted by the bank.

raw_entities.name: Legitimate Interest Processing Objection Right
raw_entities.description: Customers may object to processing based on legitimate interest grounds if the bank has no compelling reason to continue processing.
context: Legitimate interest processing: Can object if no compelling reason

raw_entities.name: Email Marketing Preference Management
raw_entities.description: Every marketing email must include a link enabling customers to manage their email marketing preferences and opt out.
context: Email preference: link in every marketing email

raw_entities.name: Phone Marketing Preference Request Process
raw_entities.description: Customers may request to opt out of phone marketing by contacting the support team.
context: Phone preference: request to support team

raw_entities.name: SMS Marketing Opt-Out Mechanism
raw_entities.description: Customers can opt out of SMS marketing by texting 'STOP' to the designated number provided in marketing messages.

raw_entities.name: Immediate Recording of Opt-Out Preferences
raw_entities.description: All customer opt-out preferences and objections must be recorded immediately in the bank's system to ensure compliance and prevent further unwanted communications.

raw_entities.name: Marketing Email Preference Link
raw_entities.description: Technical control requiring inclusion of an opt-out link in every marketing email to enable customers to manage preferences.
context: Email preference: link in every marketing email

raw_entities.name: SMS Stop Command Processing
raw_entities.description: Operational control enabling customers to send 'STOP' text messages to opt out of SMS marketing, with immediate system processing.

raw_entities.name: Preference Recording System
raw_entities.description: System control that records all customer opt-out preferences and objections immediately upon receipt to maintain audit trail and prevent non-compliance.

raw_entities.name: Direct Marketing
raw_entities.description: Risk of non-compliance with customer preferences regarding direct marketing communications across email, phone, and SMS channels.

raw_entities.name: Profiling and Automated Decision-Making
raw_entities.description: Risk of processing customer data through profiling or automated decision-making without respecting customer objection rights.

raw_entities.name: Legitimate Interest Processing Misuse
raw_entities.description: Risk of continuing to process customer data on legitimate interest grounds when customers have objected and the bank has no compelling reason to continue.
context: Legitimate interest processing: Can object if no compelling reason

raw_entities.name: Customer
raw_entities.description: Individual customers hold the right to object to processing, including direct marketing, profiling, automated decisions, and legitimate interest processing. Customers may exercise these rights through multiple channels.

raw_entities.name: Support Team
raw_entities.description: Support team is responsible for processing customer requests to opt out of phone marketing communications.
context: Phone preference: request to support team
